# Globe land data

`ne_110m_land.geojson` is converted from Natural Earth 1:110m Land, version 4.1.0:
https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/110m_physical/ne_110m_land.zip

Natural Earth map data is public domain. Coordinates are rounded to three decimal places; the Antarctica ring is oriented for D3's spherical polygon rendering. The source dataset and download information are available at https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/.
